title: LogicalModel
description: Schema for a logical data model. Captures entities, their attributes, and relationships in a technology-agnostic form including classification, PII flagging, data quality expectations, lineage references, and any unresolved modelling decisions.

model_id.description: Unique identifier for this logical model.

name.description: Human-readable name of this logical model.

scope.description: Description of the business domain or subject area covered by this model.

created_by.description: Identity of the person or agent that created this model.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this model was created.

entities.description: List of entities defined in this logical model.

entity_id.description: Unique identifier for this entity within the model.

classification.description: Data classification level for this entity.

attribute_id.description: Unique identifier for this attribute within the entity.

data_type.description: Logical data type of the attribute (e.g. string, integer, date, boolean).

optionality.description: Whether the attribute is mandatory or optional.

is_key.description: Indicates whether this attribute is part of the entity key.

is_pii.description: Indicates whether this attribute contains personally identifiable information.

classification.description: Data classification level for this attribute.

dq_expectations.description: Data quality expectations or rules applicable to this attribute.

lineage_ref.description: Reference to a lineage record for this attribute.

relationships.description: Relationships between entities defined in this model.

from_entity.description: Entity ID of the source entity in this relationship.

to_entity.description: Entity ID of the target entity in this relationship.

identifying.description: Indicates whether this is an identifying relationship.

unresolved_decisions.description: List of modelling decisions that remain unresolved and require human input.
